summary: Cloudflare service adapters; domain authority and transport-neutral ports stay in shared packages.

key_files.project-content.ts: Default D1 exact-admission/owner/tenant/deletion authorization, ProjectRoom snapshot reader, tenant-scoped immutable R2 Resource registry, and capability-use resolver. Registry facts are private infrastructure, not another Asset authority.
key_files.project-content-cloud.ts: D1/R2/ProjectRoom ports for the shared upload service and capability resolver. Adds the owner/tenant preview branch, signed chunked-import staging branch, and a bounded per-isolate capability cache.
key_files.project-asset-room.ts: ProjectRoom-side Project Asset adapter, lazily imported by the DO. Reads run on the live doc; commits re-check ownership inside the import queue, mutate a fork, then import/persist/broadcast only the new update. importProjectAsset is the one fork commit, shared with Timeline render publication.
key_files.project-asset-resources.ts: Worker-side Resource sealing shared by the Project Asset routes and video_render staging: effective tenant, digest of staged R2 bytes, first-wins registry claim and placement at the Resource locator.
key_files.project-content-multipart.ts: R2-only adapter for the optional shared multipart storage port: authenticated target-bound sessions, immutable part receipts, CAS publication ownership, incremental SHA-256 and streamed checksum-verified canonical writes. Sessions expire after 24 hours; the existing cron advances a bounded cleanup cursor. Upload IDs and private locators never grant authorization. Empty digest marks private Asset-import staging.
key_files.project-asset-import-staging.ts: R2 list/delete adapter for the shared abandoned import-staging sweep: paginates under PROJECT_ASSET_IMPORT_STAGING_PREFIX, maps uploaded time to createdAt, and is loaded only from the scheduled handler.
key_files.project-asset-references.ts: Cloudflare binding of the shared ProjectAssetReferenceResolver: ProjectRoom read (live doc in the DO, internal assets-get elsewhere), R2 Resource registry + stored-bytes check, and the same signed Resource capability the Web uses. Remote plugin references and server-side Timeline render (resolveCloudTimelineMedia, lazily imported by NodeProcessor) both resolve here. Only an id with no Project Asset falls back to a D1 library row owned by the Project owner (legacy hosted-generation output); trashed/uncommitted never do.
key_files.plugin-output-sessions.ts: Cloudflare composition of the shared run-scoped remote plugin output sessions: shared import-session token codec over JWT_SECRET, R2 staging under the import prefix (so the abandoned-staging sweep covers it), D1 ownership. sealPluginOutputUpload is the stage half; releasePluginOutputUpload deletes staging after publication and reports a failed delete with PROJECT_ASSET_IMPORT_STAGING_CLEANUP_FAILED.
key_files.cloud-project-admission.ts: D1 atomic-batch persistence adapter over shared cloud admission service; guards owner, tenant and deletion.
key_files.cloud-asset-delivery.ts: Cloud signing-secret and external-origin adapter for Resource capabilities.
key_files.asset-signing.ts: JWT_SECRET binding of the shared shared-runtime/signed-capability helper for /assets/<key>?exp=&sig= URLs. Signs with no domain prefix so the URL format and every issued signature stay byte-identical; asset-signing.test.ts pins it against node:crypto HMAC.
key_files.thumbnail.ts: renderServerFetch: the one transport to render-server (RENDER_SERVER_URL or the RENDER_CONTAINER binding). The /render protocol itself is shared-runtime/render-server.
key_files.provider-task-boundaries.test.ts: Captured protocol regressions for explicit hosted provider submit/status checks, opaque token reuse and transient HTTP classification.
key_files.minimax-video.ts: Hosted request/credential translation over the shared portable MiniMax executor; no blocking poll loop.
key_files.settings-d1.ts: D1-backed settings and historical installed-record reads/removal. Worker Action manifest installation returns structured 410 before any D1 access; real executable installation belongs to Local Host.
key_files.cloud-plugin-packages.ts: Bundled plugin packages (static JSON imports) and the executable projection surfaces of the hosted Worker. Lazy-only: never import from the startup graph.
key_files.cloud-plugin-catalog.ts: Builds the catalog on first use after registering the generated precompiled Generator validators (workerd forbids Ajv runtime compilation).
key_files.provider-accounts.ts: D1 provider accounts with AES-GCM credential envelopes shared through @clash/shared-runtime/provider-credentials; public rows expose only configured credential key names.
key_files.provider-usage.ts: D1 append-only provider usage audit using INSERT OR IGNORE on the event id, so re-appending the same event is a no-op.
key_files.provider-oauth.ts: D1 provider_oauth rows and the hosted web redirect flow. start seals verifier/state/redirect_uri with the ACTION_SECRET_KEY envelope (own salt) and never stores the authorization URL; the callback matches state only among the user's sealed flows in constant time, consumes it with a conditional update before exchanging, and writes encrypted tokens + authorized in one statement. Every failure ends as a row status with a PROVIDER_OAUTH_* code; a lapsed pending row reads as expired.
key_files.provider-oauth-config.ts: Operator-registered hosted OAuth Providers from the optional PROVIDER_OAUTH_PROVIDERS secret ([{ id, label?, flow }], flow = PluginAuthFlowSchema with tokenUrl + clientId). Parsed lazily on first use, never at Worker startup; an invalid entry fails that flow with PROVIDER_OAUTH_NOT_CONFIGURED and never echoes the client secret.
key_files.public-origin.ts: Browser-visible origin from WORKER_PUBLIC_URL, falling back to the request origin; shared by cloud sync URLs and the OAuth redirect_uri.
key_files.gateway-admin.ts: Coded JSON body, path-param and query parsing for the gateway control plane (GATEWAY_INVALID_REQUEST).
key_files.gateway-authz.ts: #353/#392/#394 the one gateway authorization module: team roles on product users (tenant_member.role owner/member, tenantRoute) and admin account roles (admin_accounts.role platform_admin, or support_agent for abuse triage without key/credential/prompt access (#356), platformRoute), checks by named permission with the role -> permission sets as data in one place; coded 401/403. No env-var grant.
key_files.admin-identity.ts: #394 admin/product identity isolation: resolveAdminRequest (the /api/v1/admin/* gate: admin session only; product session or token 403 GATEWAY_ADMIN_SESSION_REQUIRED, none 401 GATEWAY_AUTH_REQUIRED), ADMIN_SESSION_NOT_ACCEPTED (403) for an admin session on product routes.
key_files.gateway-tokens.ts: 15-minute sk_gw_ tokens: mint/renew/revoke on gateway_token (SHA-256 only, unix seconds) and the one-query D1 verifier that is the gateway-core identity port. Identity comes from the row only; parent session/clsh_/key liveness and tenant membership are checked on every verify.
